result_text:
I fixed the six patterns in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add new tests, so the new matches (a `.htm` page, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js`, `build-gradle.js`) are not checked by any test. The existing `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` ran with no output (quiet mode), which I took as passing.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match.
- **Generated JS and .NET docs:** the `// Generated by …` rule and the `<doc>` rule had `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`, which only matched a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The `.html`, `.xhtml` and `build.gradle` matches are unchanged. The `.js` and `.xml` patterns only match when the file content has the generated marker, so ordinary hand-written files stay out of the generated scope.
